delivered_contract: SEC, Yahoo, ratio, server, Financial agent and helper execution carry a validated ForecastContext plus run_id and ticker identity and fail closed when identity is absent or inconsistent.

SEC facts and filings enforce filed_at on or before as_of independently from period_end, select only the newest eligible restatement, keep future amendments invisible, and expose eligible annual and quarterly history with compact provenance.
Historical Yahoo execution uses exact adjusted start, end and as_of boundaries and cannot construct or substitute a current snapshot provider in historical mode.

All nine Financial intents and their mappers are preserved together with DCF, WACC, reverse DCF, scenarios and Monte Carlo semantics; DCF remains long-term valuation evidence and is never treated as a 21-trading-day forecast.

MonthlyFinancialFeatures is typed, deterministic and compact, retaining valuation, growth, quality, leverage, liquidity, cash-flow, filing-age, missing, degraded and versioned provenance fields; missing values remain null rather than zero.

Shared State retains compact references and features rather than raw filings, provider payloads or reasoning, and the canonical Financial checker prompt uses prompt_finance_checker.py with the legacy typo module removed.
Financial MCP, lifecycle and logging telemetry is measured, bounded and allowlisted across the required twelve boundaries, excluding raw arguments, outputs, exceptions and financial scalar payloads.
known_limitations: No live SEC, Yahoo or other financial-provider validation was authorized or used as acceptance evidence; closure is based on deterministic offline fixtures, mocks and regressions.
No external database access, migration application, seed, deletion, deploy, commit or push was authorized or performed.
Stage 06 remains PENDING, NOT_STARTED and inactive until separately authorized.
